claim: Patchline ships a multi-repository coordination protocol for cross-service migrations with two-phase safety. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the two-phase claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make multi-repo-coordination-gate`.
